# Air Traffic & Drone

# Technology Operations

### Safe, coordinated, scalable solutions for unmanned and autonomous operations environments

### We are a technology company built on years of complex airspace management and UAS operations
### experience.

### This foundation uniquely positions us to deliver autonomous airspace management solutions that
### serve both regulators and operators.

[ Let's Talk ][17]

## From integrated awareness to coordinated resilience outcomes through orchestration

Today's national airspace operates under static regulations, opaque approvals and fragmented
systems; an unsustainable framework that moves at paper-speed and threatens airspace sovereignty and
security.

Legacy systems are siloed, lack real-time coordination, and can't scale with growing automated
aircraft. Airspace authorities also lack unified digital visibility across manned, unmanned and UAS
threats.

We provide an open modular system that enables a safe, coordinated airspace.

## **Scaling UAS Operations Through Regulatory-Tech Synergy**

We turn complex FAA compliance into a simple partnership. Through our agency model, your team can
operate advanced UAS operations at scale without navigating the time-consuming regulatory process
yourself.  

We handle compliance, oversight, and technology requirements - you focus on your business operations
and operate with Uncrew.

It's UAS advancement made accessible.

[ Learn more ][18]
[ Learn more ][19]
 

## Our Core Technology

## **ATOMx**

The universal layer that aligns authorizations, sensing, and policy coordination across operational
domains.
* **Scale Beyond Paper:**  Cryptographic identity and intent assurance that establishes who, what,
  and why for each mission
* **Dynamic Airspace Rules:**  Policy-driven rule propagation and coordination that supports
  real-time compliance across systems
* **Threat Mitigation:**  Integrated threat-awareness and response coordination layer that aligns
  detection, assessment, and mitigation systems

## Uncrew

An open autonomy platform that seamlessly works with any drone, replaces manual piloting, and brings
safe, compliant, and scalable UAS operations to the skies.
* **Single Pane of Glass:**  A centralized view provides a centralized view of all drone flights
  with routing optimized for safe, deconflicted airspace
* **An operating system for any drone:**  works with any drone, providing adaptive control for
  delivery and inspection missions
* **Team Workspace:**  share data, supervise missions across teams and partners

[ Book a Demo ][20]

## Our Vision

#### To revolutionize airspace management and situational awareness while advancing UAS autonomy
#### without vendor lock-in. By uniting regulatory oversight with operational excellence, we create
#### a safe, coordinated, autonomous airspace that will define Advanced Air Mobility's future.

## What We Believe

### Safe, coordinated, autonomous airspace requires three key pillars:

#### Awareness: Complete situational understanding

#### Control: Coordinated orchestration and automation

#### Assurance: Resilient, continuous performance

What Makes Us Different?
* ## Comprehensive Integration:
  
  **Our products work independently or as a complete ecosystem for government or commercial users.
  **
* ## Regulatory + Operations Enablement:
  
  **We streamline complex regulations to enable operators for advanced operations.**
* ## Open Platform, Unlimited Scale:
  
  **Open, interoperable architecture that is purpose-built for large-scale deployment.**
* ## Future-Ready:
  
  **Supporting today's operations while preparing for tomorrow's regulations.**
* ## Proven Experience:
  
  **Real-world operational background, not just theoretical solutions.**
* ## Seasoned Team:
  
  **Veterans from military, LEO, special operations & airspace policy.**

## The Outcome:

### **When regulatory and operator tools work together, they create one coordinated, safe, scalable,
### autonomous airspace ecosystem.**

# Powered by farmers for farmers

[A vast yellow field of flowering plants under a partly cloudy sky with patches of blue.]

# About
# AGX

At AGX Drone Distributors, we’re committed to bringing the best agricultural drone technology to
farmers across Australia.

We partner with world-leading brands including EAVision, XAG, and DJI to deliver reliable,
high-performance drones built for Australian conditions. From broadacre to horticulture and
forestry, our drones are helping growers and contractors lift efficiency, accuracy, and
profitability.

Beyond sales, AGX also operates one of Australia’s largest agricultural drone contracting fleets,
providing professional spraying, spreading, and mapping services nationwide. With thousands of
hectares completed each season, our team has hands-on experience that ensures we know exactly what
works in the field.

Backed by real-world knowledge, a strong safety culture, and nationwide support, AGX is more than a
distributor — we’re an operational partner helping drive the future of smart farming across
Australia

[Close-up of a weathered concrete post with a rusted chain hanging from it, outdoors in a field with
green grass and trees in the background, during sunset.]

# Powered by farmers for farmers

[A vast yellow field of flowering plants under a partly cloudy sky with patches of blue.]

# About
# AGX

At AGX Drone Distributors, we’re committed to bringing the best agricultural drone technology to
farmers across Australia.

We partner with world-leading brands including EAVision, XAG, and DJI to deliver reliable,
high-performance drones built for Australian conditions. From broadacre to horticulture and
forestry, our drones are helping growers and contractors lift efficiency, accuracy, and
profitability.

Beyond sales, AGX also operates one of Australia’s largest agricultural drone contracting fleets,
providing professional spraying, spreading, and mapping services nationwide. With thousands of
hectares completed each season, our team has hands-on experience that ensures we know exactly what
works in the field.

Backed by real-world knowledge, a strong safety culture, and nationwide support, AGX is more than a
distributor — we’re an operational partner helping drive the future of smart farming across
Australia

[Close-up of a weathered concrete post with a rusted chain hanging from it, outdoors in a field with
green grass and trees in the background, during sunset.]

# INNOVATIVE UAS TECHNOLOGY

[Learn More][22]

### [INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGY STACK][23]

Accelerating Defence Innovation, Redefined at ALTUS-LSA, we don’t follow—we lead. As a disruptive
force in defence technology, we identify tomorrow’s challenges today, self-fund the R&D to solve
them, and bring fully developed, deployable systems straight to market. Our rapid innovation cycle
turns ideas into operational solutions in months, not years—delivering unmatched value.

### [EMPOWERING A SAFER & SMARTER WORLD VIA DUAL USE UAS!][24]

At the intersection of defence precision and civilian innovation lies the true power of dual-use UAS
technology. These platforms are not just flying machines—they’re force multipliers. From protecting
borders and saving lives in crisis zones, to monitoring forests and inspecting infrastructure, they
prove that the same cutting-edge capability can serve both security and society.

### [UAS END USER CENTRICITY][25]

Our platforms are built with modular, customizable features—empowering users to adapt, expand, and
integrate with purpose. From specialized payloads to emerging technologies, every function supports
a greater mission. At ALTUS-LSA, we don’t just serve clients—we stand by partners. With a
customer-first mindset, we deliver rapid-response support and immediate spare parts availability
throughout Greece and Europe.

## We are about Quality and Trust

### [Unmanned Systems][26]

Our strength lies in its deep domain knowledge and operational experience across Defence, Security,
and Industrial Sectors.

### [Operational team][27]

Operational Excellence, Powered by High Caliber Personnel. Behind every successful mission is a team
that’s flown it before.

### [Quality & Certifications][28]

Excellence is not just a benchmark, It fuels our dedication to designing, developing, and delivering
Unmanned Aircraft Systems that embody the highest standards.

## Featured Products

### [ATLAS 8 Electric][29]

The ATLAS 8 family is a heavy lifter multi-copter addressing the emerging requirements of the small
cargo (goods, weapons, search and rescue means, etc) and last mile (commercial products) transport
market.

### [ATLAS 204 – A20][30]

ATLAS 204 A20 Drone System is designed to deliver high reliability & mission oriented multi-rotor
capabilities in the fields of defence, security & industrial surveillance.

### [ATLAS 4][31]

ATLAS 4 Drone System is designed to deliver “out of the normal” multi-rotor capabilities in the
fields of surveillance, industrial monitoring and small cargo delivery applications.

### [DRONE HANGAR][32]

The Drone Hangar solution operates with our multi-rotor drones like an expert pilot and enables
autonomous remote operations at hazardous environments.

### [EDOMON][33]

EDOMON is a Hybrid VTOL UAV based on Supervolo Aerial Platform, designed to deliver reliable and
efficient ISR Operations for the Law enforcement, Civil Protection and Defence Market.

### [M3NTOR][34]

M3NTOR is an innovative network centric, hierarchical , C3 assets and mission management system with
the capability to control and navigate multiple drones in a 3D projected environment.

# INNOVATIVE UAS TECHNOLOGY

[Learn More][22]

### [INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGY STACK][23]

Accelerating Defence Innovation, Redefined at ALTUS-LSA, we don’t follow—we lead. As a disruptive
force in defence technology, we identify tomorrow’s challenges today, self-fund the R&D to solve
them, and bring fully developed, deployable systems straight to market. Our rapid innovation cycle
turns ideas into operational solutions in months, not years—delivering unmatched value.

### [EMPOWERING A SAFER & SMARTER WORLD VIA DUAL USE UAS!][24]

At the intersection of defence precision and civilian innovation lies the true power of dual-use UAS
technology. These platforms are not just flying machines—they’re force multipliers. From protecting
borders and saving lives in crisis zones, to monitoring forests and inspecting infrastructure, they
prove that the same cutting-edge capability can serve both security and society.

### [UAS END USER CENTRICITY][25]

Our platforms are built with modular, customizable features—empowering users to adapt, expand, and
integrate with purpose. From specialized payloads to emerging technologies, every function supports
a greater mission. At ALTUS-LSA, we don’t just serve clients—we stand by partners. With a
customer-first mindset, we deliver rapid-response support and immediate spare parts availability
throughout Greece and Europe.

## We are about Quality and Trust

### [Unmanned Systems][26]

Our strength lies in its deep domain knowledge and operational experience across Defence, Security,
and Industrial Sectors.

### [Operational team][27]

Operational Excellence, Powered by High Caliber Personnel. Behind every successful mission is a team
that’s flown it before.

### [Quality & Certifications][28]

Excellence is not just a benchmark, It fuels our dedication to designing, developing, and delivering
Unmanned Aircraft Systems that embody the highest standards.

## Featured Products

### [ATLAS 8 Electric][29]

The ATLAS 8 family is a heavy lifter multi-copter addressing the emerging requirements of the small
cargo (goods, weapons, search and rescue means, etc) and last mile (commercial products) transport
market.

### [ATLAS 204 – A20][30]

ATLAS 204 A20 Drone System is designed to deliver high reliability & mission oriented multi-rotor
capabilities in the fields of defence, security & industrial surveillance.

### [ATLAS 4][31]

ATLAS 4 Drone System is designed to deliver “out of the normal” multi-rotor capabilities in the
fields of surveillance, industrial monitoring and small cargo delivery applications.

### [DRONE HANGAR][32]

The Drone Hangar solution operates with our multi-rotor drones like an expert pilot and enables
autonomous remote operations at hazardous environments.

### [EDOMON][33]

EDOMON is a Hybrid VTOL UAV based on Supervolo Aerial Platform, designed to deliver reliable and
efficient ISR Operations for the Law enforcement, Civil Protection and Defence Market.

### [M3NTOR][34]

M3NTOR is an innovative network centric, hierarchical , C3 assets and mission management system with
the capability to control and navigate multiple drones in a 3D projected environment.

# Kaspersky Antidrone – an agile system for detecting and counteracting drones

The Kaspersky Antidrone detection and counteraction system lets you detect, classify, and even
mitigate various types and classes of civilian UAVs, if such action is necessary and has been
authorized. The configuration of each system is unique and depends on the specific threat model.

The cost of the product depends on the specific requirements and technical capabilities of the
customer. To calculate the exact cost of the product and purchase it, please contact an official
partner of Kaspersky in your region.

[Contact us][15]
Software from a world leader in cybersecurity
Kaspersky is an international company that has been engaged in information security since 1997. Our
in-depth expertise and years of experience are at the heart of all our next-generation security
solutions and services that safeguard businesses, critical infrastructure, and industry.
Neural networks and artificial intelligence
Kaspersky Antidrone uses unique software that is unrivaled on the market. Algorithms powered by AI
and neural networks ensure the fastest processing of data received from various types of hardware
sensors and provide comprehensive UAV analytics in a single interface that can be understood by
operators without technical skills.
High-grade hardware
Only a suite of hardware sensors running on software algorithms, rather than a collection of
separate technologies, can provide the required level of antidrone protection in the modern world.
We use our proprietary hardware modules and the best available third-party hardware sensors, which
have passed internal testing.
Ecosystemic and scalable approach
At the architectural level, the solution is intended to be modular, scalable and form part of an
ecosystem. This allows our customers not only to purchase a final product, but also to invest in a
comprehensive, future-proof security system. Kaspersky Antidrone integrates with industrial security
systems, interfaces with outdoor security cameras, and provides reliable UAV monitoring.
KASPERSKY ANTIDRONE

## Customers

State-of-the-art unmanned aerial vehicles are capable not only of reconnaissance, but also of posing
genuine risks to your infrastructure, business, and the safety and security of people. The Kaspersky
Antidrone system identifies threats in the earliest stages to provide timely warnings and effective
countermeasures.

### Protection of energy sector from drones

Integration of counter-unmanned aircraft system into the existing security infrastructure of energy
sector facilities.

### Protection of DPCs from drones

Prevention of unauthorized drone access to critical IT infrastructure at data processing centers.

### Protection of substations from drones

Airspace monitoring above electrical substations and protection from UAVs to prevent damage or
unauthorized observation.

### Protection of fuel storage tanks from drones

Control and protection of storage areas containing fuel and other hazardous substances from
potential drone threats.

### Protection of enterprises from drones

Complex approach to the detection, identification and suppression of UAVs over manufacturing
facilities.

### Regional counter-UAV system

The Kaspersky Antidrone software platform can combine anti-drone systems from different
manufacturers into one unified system and monitor UAVs from a single operations center. The software
facilitates machine learning and neural network technologies. It ensures high-speed data processing
from a variety of hardware sensors and provides comprehensive UAV analytics in a unified interface.

# Kaspersky Antidrone – an agile system for detecting and counteracting drones

The Kaspersky Antidrone detection and counteraction system lets you detect, classify, and even
mitigate various types and classes of civilian UAVs, if such action is necessary and has been
authorized. The configuration of each system is unique and depends on the specific threat model.

The cost of the product depends on the specific requirements and technical capabilities of the
customer. To calculate the exact cost of the product and purchase it, please contact an official
partner of Kaspersky in your region.

[Contact us][15]
Software from a world leader in cybersecurity
Kaspersky is an international company that has been engaged in information security since 1997. Our
in-depth expertise and years of experience are at the heart of all our next-generation security
solutions and services that safeguard businesses, critical infrastructure, and industry.
Neural networks and artificial intelligence
Kaspersky Antidrone uses unique software that is unrivaled on the market. Algorithms powered by AI
and neural networks ensure the fastest processing of data received from various types of hardware
sensors and provide comprehensive UAV analytics in a single interface that can be understood by
operators without technical skills.
High-grade hardware
Only a suite of hardware sensors running on software algorithms, rather than a collection of
separate technologies, can provide the required level of antidrone protection in the modern world.
We use our proprietary hardware modules and the best available third-party hardware sensors, which
have passed internal testing.
Ecosystemic and scalable approach
At the architectural level, the solution is intended to be modular, scalable and form part of an
ecosystem. This allows our customers not only to purchase a final product, but also to invest in a
comprehensive, future-proof security system. Kaspersky Antidrone integrates with industrial security
systems, interfaces with outdoor security cameras, and provides reliable UAV monitoring.
KASPERSKY ANTIDRONE

## Customers

State-of-the-art unmanned aerial vehicles are capable not only of reconnaissance, but also of posing
genuine risks to your infrastructure, business, and the safety and security of people. The Kaspersky
Antidrone system identifies threats in the earliest stages to provide timely warnings and effective
countermeasures.

### Protection of energy sector from drones

Integration of counter-unmanned aircraft system into the existing security infrastructure of energy
sector facilities.

### Protection of DPCs from drones

Prevention of unauthorized drone access to critical IT infrastructure at data processing centers.

### Protection of substations from drones

Airspace monitoring above electrical substations and protection from UAVs to prevent damage or
unauthorized observation.

### Protection of fuel storage tanks from drones

Control and protection of storage areas containing fuel and other hazardous substances from
potential drone threats.

### Protection of enterprises from drones

Complex approach to the detection, identification and suppression of UAVs over manufacturing
facilities.

### Regional counter-UAV system

The Kaspersky Antidrone software platform can combine anti-drone systems from different
manufacturers into one unified system and monitor UAVs from a single operations center. The software
facilitates machine learning and neural network technologies. It ensures high-speed data processing
from a variety of hardware sensors and provides comprehensive UAV analytics in a unified interface.

## NEWS

[ [BAYRAKTAR KIZILELMA STRIKES WITH SUPERSONIC MISSILE] ][40]
[BAYRAKTAR KIZILELMA STRIKES WITH SUPERSONIC MISSILE][41]

The Bayraktar KIZILELMA Unmanned Fighter Aircraft, which marked the beginning of a new chapter in
the history of global aviation, successfully completed its first firing test with an air-to-ground
supersonic missile. During the test, which took place in Merzifon, KIZILELMA S2 successfully struck
its target with the JET-230 supersonic missile under its wings.

15 July 2026
[ [LEONARDO AND BAYKAR SET MAJOR MILESTONE FOR ADVANCED CREWED/UNCREWED CAPABILITY DEVELOPMENT WITH
SUCCESSFUL FIRST K-SWARM LIVE TRIALS] ][42]
[LEONARDO AND BAYKAR SET MAJOR MILESTONE FOR ADVANCED CREWED/UNCREWED CAPABILITY DEVELOPMENT WITH
SUCCESSFUL FIRST K-SWARM LIVE TRIALS][43]

Leonardo M-346 airplanes and Bayraktar KIZILELMA unmanned fighter aircraft have successfully
performed a series of joint autonomous formation flights as part of the K-SWARM programme.

22 June 2026
[ [BAYKAR PROVIDES EDUCATIONAL SUPPORT FOR PALESTINIAN STUDENTS] ][44]
[BAYKAR PROVIDES EDUCATIONAL SUPPORT FOR PALESTINIAN STUDENTS][45]

Baykar and YTB Launch "Palestine Joint Scholarship Program" to Cover All Education, Accommodation,
and Travel Expenses for 200 Palestinian Students Studying in Türkiye.

19 June 2026
[ [MIZRAK INTELLIGENT LOITERING MUNITION TO DEBUT AT SAHA 2026] ][46]
[MIZRAK INTELLIGENT LOITERING MUNITION TO DEBUT AT SAHA 2026][47]

Indigenously and originally developed by Baykar, the MIZRAK Intelligent Loitering Munition — set to
become a game-changing force with its range exceeding 1,000 kilometers and AI-assisted autonomous
capabilities — will be unveiled for the first time at SAHA 2026, where the global defense industry
will converge.

30 April 2026
[ [BAYKAR'S NEXT-GENERATION PLATFORMS, THE K2 KAMIKAZE UAV AND THE SİVRİSİNEK LOITERING MUNITION,
TAKE TO THE FIELD] ][48]
[BAYKAR'S NEXT-GENERATION PLATFORMS, THE K2 KAMIKAZE UAV AND THE SİVRİSİNEK LOITERING MUNITION, TAKE
TO THE FIELD][49]

Indigenously and originally developed by Baykar, the next-generation kamikaze UAV K2 and Sivrisinek
loitering munition unveiled the combat concept of the future during a demonstration held in Keşan.
The tests showcased AI-supported swarm autonomy, GNSS-independent navigation, automatic target
detection, and strike capabilities. The K2 Kamikaze UAV and Sivrisinek will be exhibited to the
public for the first time at SAHA 2026, taking place on 5-9 May.

24 April 2026
[ [FERGANI’S FIFTH SATELLITE IN ORBIT!] ][50]
[FERGANI’S FIFTH SATELLITE IN ORBIT!][51]

Fergani Space’s fifth test satellite, FGN-100-D3 – developed entirely with indigenous capabilities —
has been launched into space. The next-generation indigenous satellite, weighing 113 kg and equipped
with communications and navigation capabilities, has successfully reached its designated orbit and
commenced operations.

30 March 2026

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What data do you offer?

We provide information on biotech companies. The data we provide includes:

* **Company info:**
  * Name
  * Description
  * Private/Public/ Ticker
  * Size (employees)
  * Website
  * LinkedIn
  * Location (city, state, region (U.S.), country)
  * Technology areas (e.g, biologic, antibody, lentiviral)
  * Disease areas (e.g., cancer) / Disease(s) (e.g., AML))
  * Recent funding info
* **Contact info:**
  * Name
  * Title
  * Linked-In
  * Email
* **Pipeline / lead asset info:**
  * Embedded [ClinTrials.gov][37] search module
  * Public & selected private cell/gene therapy companies
    * Asset name
    * Disease / indication
    * Development stage
    * Next catalyst event date (for public companies)
* Clinical Trials

effective training environments. By empowering defence forces with smarter tools and greater

## Revolutionizing Agave Farming: Using Agras T50 Drones to Spray Agave

### Solutions

DJI Agriculture not only empowers agriculture professionals with powerful equipment but also
provides intelligent solutions that save time and increase workflow, benefiting a wide range of
customers from farmers and growers to agricultural cooperation and service agencies.

[Grain Crops]

### Grain Crops

Our solutions provide digital, informative, intelligent, and precise field management for grain
crops such as rice, wheat, and corn. This empowers agricultural operators with more convenient and
efficient options, reduces operation costs, improves crop quality, and increases yield rate.

[Commercial Crops]

### Commercial Crops

We also provide digital, informative, intelligent, and precise management solutions for commercial

##### Oil & Gas

We work on offshore and onshore refineries, plants and construction sites offering close visual and

confined spaces.

pre-existences.

### DroneXperts is a startup company in that will meet the growing demand for professional drone
### pilots and end-to-end drone services.

In our fast-paced technological era, drones have become a revolutionizing force in various fields,
from agriculture to [filmmaking][57]. Their ability to revolutionize processes and optimize
efficiency has made expertise in drone technology a necessary skill for professionals. Drone Xperts
is leading this technological revolution with its highly organized training programs that equip
students with the necessary expertise to thrive in the UAV industry's demanding climate.

The practical skills obtained through DroneXperts training programs translate directly into
practical applications. Whether it is conducting aerial surveys for construction, delivering
stunning footage for media productions, or [elevating precision agriculture][58], the training
equips professionals with the ability to utilize drone technology effectively and innovatively. The
programs emphasize hands-on training, so the attendees are more than capable of transcending
obstacles and seizing opportunities in their industries.

DroneXperts offers a unique blend of online and in-person drone training classes, sales,
consultation, and related services. Operating from a strategically located 2,000 sq ft [retail space
in downtown Elkader][59], Iowa, our company is well-positioned to serve a diverse clientele ranging
from individual enthusiasts to large corporations and government agencies.

DroneXperts offers a gateway to mastering drone technology, providing professionals with the skills
and expertise needed to excel in their careers. By choosing DroneXperts, individuals are investing
in their future, gaining access to cutting-edge training and joining a community of innovators.
Elevate your career and become a leader in drone technology with expert guidance from DroneXperts.
Join us in shaping the future of UAV technology and unlock your potential today!

from agriculture to [filmmaking][57]. Their ability to revolutionize processes and optimize
efficiency has made expertise in drone technology a necessary skill for professionals. Drone Xperts
is leading this technological revolution with its highly organized training programs that equip

practical applications. Whether it is conducting aerial surveys for construction, delivering
stunning footage for media productions, or [elevating precision agriculture][58], the training
equips professionals with the ability to utilize drone technology effectively and innovatively. The
programs emphasize hands-on training, so the attendees are more than capable of transcending
obstacles and seizing opportunities in their industries.

consultation, and related services. Operating from a strategically located 2,000 sq ft [retail space
in downtown Elkader][59], Iowa, our company is well-positioned to serve a diverse clientele ranging
from individual enthusiasts to large corporations and government agencies.

DroneXperts offers a gateway to mastering drone technology, providing professionals with the skills
and expertise needed to excel in their careers. By choosing DroneXperts, individuals are investing
in their future, gaining access to cutting-edge training and joining a community of innovators.
Elevate your career and become a leader in drone technology with expert guidance from DroneXperts.
Join us in shaping the future of UAV technology and unlock your potential today!

At FlapOne Aviation, our motto is to transform the drone industry in India. Drones have become the
new standard in today's industries, ranging from agriculture to rescue operations. This is the

that may arise.

Quality, safety, and innovation are our standpoints, and we do not refrain from providing the
absolute best that we have for our students and clients. All the programs in our kitty are aligned
well with international standards. Our expert advice, mentorship and resources are beneficial for
both novice and experienced professionals alike.

# The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Bible

This project works from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church’s canonical tradition, preserved
through the ancient Geʽez manuscript lineage and transmitted to the Church through centuries of
faithful use.

When compared alongside the King James Bible, differences in wording, cadence, and structure reveal
how translation traditions can shape the way God’s character is heard—sometimes emphasizing
immediacy, severity, or judgment in English where older Semitic traditions preserve sequence,
restraint, and relational continuity.

The Ethiopian canon represents the oldest continuously used biblical tradition in the world, with
manuscripts dating to the 5th–6th century AD. Its textual witness does not change events or
doctrine, but often preserves tone and narrative flow in ways that allow readers to perceive
continuity between the God of the Old Testament and the Christ revealed in Jesus.

This study does not seek to replace Scripture, but to listen more carefully to it—by placing the
King James Bible and the Ethiopian Orthodox canon side by side and allowing the language itself to
speak.

convenience and flexibility upon the "Spring Knife" in terms of both transport and deployment.

# WELCOME TO THE NEW FRONTIER

## EVERY MISSION MATTERS

We build drones that go where others can't. Our systems command every environment, from confined
spaces to open skies, turning impossible missions into reality thanks to their unrivalled
performance. When it matters, Orqa delivers.
Follow us into the new.

[try orqa][26]

## TECHNOLOGY

### BUILT TO DOMINATE

Unlike competitors who just assemble third-party parts, Orqa’s full vertical integration means we
design and manufacture every component ourselves. This gives us the freedom to fine-tune
functionality and optimize performance where it really counts.

## MANUFACTURING

### SCALABLESUPPLY CHAIN

Many drones rely on critical Chinese components, something that’s both a security risk and a
potential barrier to scaling. Orqa is different. We manufacture every component we use, making our
supply chain stable and secure.

High End equipment for FPV drones.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Partnerbase?

Partnerbase is the world's largest directory of B2B technology and channel partnerships. It catalogs
partnerships between companies across the global B2B ecosystem, helping you discover who partners
with whom.

How many partnerships does Partnerbase track?

Partnerbase tracks over 981,864 partnerships between 1,115,305 companies.

Where does Partnerbase's data come from?

Partnerbase tracks 1,115,305 companies using data from Trace (tracedata.ai), which continuously
crawls the web — partner pages, integration directories, marketplace listings, and press releases —
to discover and verify partnerships across the B2B ecosystem.

How do I find a company's partners?

Search for any company on Partnerbase to see their full list of technology and channel partners,
partnership ecosystem map, and shared partner connections.

# The open standards for drone hardware

Pixhawk open standards provides readily available hardware specifications and guidelines for drone
systems development

[Download the Standards][7][Participate][8]

##  The reference standards

All aspects of mechanical and electrical specifications for creating interoperable drone system
components

## Autopilot

Flight management unit 

[ Learn more][9]

## Payload

Cameras, gimbals, actuators

[ Learn more][10]

## Smart Battery

Battery management unit

[Learn more][11]

## Benefits for adopters



### Accelerate time to market with reference designs



### Reduce R&D overheads with jointly engineered solutions



### Scale product interoperability with the ecosystem

###### THE ORIGIN

## A decade of rich history and
## a fast growing community

A decade ago, “Pixhawk” was a student project at ETH Zurich. Little did the team know that it would
end up having such a large influence on the drone industry. During this time, the team created
MAVLink, Pixhawk, PX4, and QGroundcontrol — which are today’s most used standards for flight control
hardware and autopilot software in the drone industry. This was the beginning of a story of a very
successful open source project outperforming individual corporate development.

[Read the story from Lorenz Meier, the founder of Pixhawk and PX4][12]


## Created by industry leaders 

Pixhawk is the defacto standard for those who build the ubiquitous autonomous systems that will
support a better world for humanity.

Arnaud Thiercelin

Head of Enterprise Product, Auterion

NXP is pleased to participate in the development of an open standard by working with the community.
Together, we ensure quality, safety, and efficiency of modern autonomous systems products.

Iain Galloway

Drone Program Lead, NXP

At Freefly we greatly value simple and effective open standards and protocols, and we are excited to
help create these for the industry!

Cory Schwarzmiller

Senior Embedded Systems Engineer, Freefly

The Pixhawk Smart Battery Standard will increase the safety, interoperability, and professionalism
of the open source UAV ecosystem.

Alex Klimaj

Founder, ARK Electronics

###### THE ORIGIN

## A decade of rich history and
## a fast growing community

A decade ago, “Pixhawk” was a student project at ETH Zurich. Little did the team know that it would
end up having such a large influence on the drone industry. During this time, the team created
MAVLink, Pixhawk, PX4, and QGroundcontrol — which are today’s most used standards for flight control
hardware and autopilot software in the drone industry. This was the beginning of a story of a very
successful open source project outperforming individual corporate development.

[Read the story from Lorenz Meier, the founder of Pixhawk and PX4][12]


## Created by industry leaders 

Pixhawk is the defacto standard for those who build the ubiquitous autonomous systems that will
support a better world for humanity.

Arnaud Thiercelin

Head of Enterprise Product, Auterion

NXP is pleased to participate in the development of an open standard by working with the community.
Together, we ensure quality, safety, and efficiency of modern autonomous systems products.

Iain Galloway

Drone Program Lead, NXP

At Freefly we greatly value simple and effective open standards and protocols, and we are excited to
help create these for the industry!

Cory Schwarzmiller

Senior Embedded Systems Engineer, Freefly

The Pixhawk Smart Battery Standard will increase the safety, interoperability, and professionalism
of the open source UAV ecosystem.

Alex Klimaj

# ‍Physical AI

## **In collaboration with**

**Over 6M Acres Imaged**

Earth is constantly changing. Capture it in ultra-high resolution through the world’s largest
standardized drone imagery network — powering maps, applications, and physical AI grounded in
reality.

[
Book a Demo
][21]

## Data for geospatial and AI systems that need to understand the physical world

[

### Next-gen data products

Standardized and ultra-high resolution
* Gaussian splats
* 3D point clouds + orthomosaics
* Structured oblique + nadir imagery

][22][

### Create living world models

Continuously update city-scale models with time-series data captures.
* Spatial AI model training
* Robotic simulations
* Inrastructure inspections

][23]
[

### Enable portfolio intelligence

Maintain Al-driven visibility into asset conditions across portfolios.
* Development state tracking
* Asset condition modeling
* Investor reporting automation

][24][
[Aerial view of a residential neighborhood with houses, some under construction, and autumn
trees.][Aerial view of a suburban neighborhood showing houses, roads, trees, and a cul-de-sac.]

### Detect real-world change

Enable real-world change detection to your sites and assets with regularly updated imagery
* Progress verification
* Site change detection
* Risk prediction

][25]

## From request to real-world data in days, not months

Spexi runs a distributed network of drone pilots ready to capture your city on demand.
Three steps from request to ready-to-use data.

### Request coverage where it matters

Define the locations, assets, or regions where you need imagery — wherever your models need better
visibility or your city needs updated ground truth.

[

## What Underpriced Actually Helps You Decide

Underpriced is designed for the real decisions that determine whether a flip is worth your time:
what an item actually sells for, what fees and shipping do to your margin, how quickly it is likely
to move, and whether the risk profile is acceptable for your bankroll.

### Comp Research

Check recent sold data instead of relying on wishful active listings. That helps you spot false
optimism before you buy and keeps your pricing anchored to what buyers actually paid.

### Margin Protection

Account for platform fees, shipping drag, and item-specific costs before you commit. Small math
errors repeated across dozens of flips quietly erase good sourcing work.

### Faster Skip Decisions

Not every item deserves a deep dive. Underpriced helps you identify passes faster so your time and
capital stay available for inventory with stronger demand and cleaner upside.

For newer resellers, that means fewer beginner mistakes like buying into bad comps, underestimating
shipping, or confusing gross sale price with actual profit. For experienced sellers, it means
compressing research time and standardizing decisions across higher listing volume.

The public site, free tools, and blog exist to make those decisions clearer before you ever open the
paid experience. The app simply takes the same logic deeper with live analysis, saved history, and
workflow shortcuts built for people actively sourcing and listing inventory every week.

## Questions from Flippers

Why should I pay when eBay sold is free?

Time is money. Checking eBay sold takes 2-3 minutes per item: searching, scrolling through results,
mentally calculating fees and shipping. At a garage sale with 50 potential items, that's 2+ hours of
standing around researching. We do it in 30 seconds with instant profit calculations, platform fee
breakdowns, and red flags. Same 50 items? 25 minutes total. Plus everything is saved, tracked, and
organized. The paid tiers cost less than one decent flip - and you'll find that flip faster.

How is this different from checking eBay sold or asking AI myself?

Three things: speed, accuracy, and tracking. Asking ChatGPT or similar gives you generic guesses
without real market data. We combine instant AI identification with actual sales data, then
automatically calculate platform fees, shipping estimates, and net ROI. Plus, every analysis is
saved to your account so you can track what you've researched, compare items over time, and move
items directly to your Flip Tracker.

Where does the price data come from?

We aggregate pricing data from multiple sources including completed sales, active listings, and
historical market trends. The AI identifies your item from the photo, cross-references comparable
items across platforms, and synthesizes this data to provide accurate market values with confidence
levels based on how many data points we found.

What can I analyze? Does it work on any item?

Anything you can photograph. Electronics, clothing, collectibles, toys, tools, furniture: if people
buy it on eBay, we can analyze it. Works with photos you take, screenshots from FB Marketplace,
OfferUp, Craigslist, or any other source. The AI is trained on millions of product images.

How accurate is the net profit calculation?

We use current platform fee rates (eBay 13.25%, Mercari 10%, Poshmark 20%, FB Marketplace 0%).
Shipping estimates are based on typical costs for the item category and size. Your actual results
may vary slightly based on your negotiated shipping rates or promotional fee discounts, but you'll
be within a few dollars.

Built-in inventory management. When you decide to BUY an item, add it to your tracker in one click.

numbers, ROI by category, average days to sell, and exportable reports for taxes.

The weekly Ad, also called circular ads, is an influential marketing tool retailers use to advertise
their goods and services. They are generally published in print or on the Internet and offer
discounts on various products.

Retailers utilize weekly advertisements to draw new customers, promote returning business, and
reduce stock. Weekly ads are an excellent method for saving money shopping. Through browsing weekly
ads of your preferred merchants, you can get discounts on everything from groceries and clothing to
electronic gadgets.

You can also utilize the weekly advertisements for planning your shopping trip so that you know what
you need to purchase and where to buy it.

There are several methods to locate weekly ads. They are usually found in the local paper or look
them up online. There are also a lot of websites that combine weekly ads from various retail
outlets.

After you’ve found the weekly advertisements you’re interested in, you can begin planning your
shopping trip. Compare prices across different stores and look for promo codes and coupons that
could save you more money.

reduce stock. Weekly ads are an excellent method for saving money shopping. Through browsing weekly
ads of your preferred merchants, you can get discounts on everything from groceries and clothing to
electronic gadgets.

you need to purchase and where to buy it.

outlets.

shopping trip. Compare prices across different stores and look for promo codes and coupons that
